text: I understand you're in a bit of a bind with your friend's novel. It's great that you're thinking ahead and wanting to be considerate of their needs. To handle this situation, I would recommend reaching out to your friend before Saturday and being upfront about your progress. Let them know that you haven't finished the novel yet and ask if it would be okay to keep it for another week. Be clear that you're willing to return it on the original date if they need it, and that any extension would depend on their agreement. It's essential to be honest and respectful of their time, and not assume that they'll be okay with the delay.
